newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Michelin picks up more RSS3 rubber in Singapore.
newsitem.headline: Michelin picks up more RSS3 rubber in Singapore.

text.p: Michelin bought several hundred more tonnes of RSS3 rubber on Thursday in an otherwise featureless Singapore rubber market, dealers said.
"Michelin bought again this afternoon. With prices coming off, they decided to pick up more RSS3 in the market as part of their monthly programme," a dealer said.

"Michelin is engaged in their monthly buying for RSS3 rubber. I don't think they have finished their buying. But aside from Michelin, there's nobody else in the market. It was fairly dull," another trader said.
It was the fourth straight day that Michelin was in the market. Bridgestone bought a consignment of TSR20 rubber earlier in the week, but was not seen in today's trading.

Holidays in predominantly Moslem Malaysia and Indonesia, where they observed the Prophet Muhammad's birthday, kept activity in the Singapore rubber market subdued, dealers said. "Michelin provided the only action. The holidays in the two countries kept things quiet around here," a dealer said.
At around 0945 GMT, September RSS3 was seen at 93.00 U.S. cents a kg from the previous 93.25 cents.
